title: Dispatch: separate obligation/evidence namespaces, ground relevance and absence (attempt 6)
description:
Fresh full review of PR #477 at 71d4eed: three P1, one P2, one P3. The reviewer
states NO new defect class was found — these are incomplete resolutions of
existing contract invariants — so the churn rule does not yet require rescoping
and ONE more correction round is permitted. It is the last one before the stop
rule bites. Sibling PRs #475 and #476 have already triggered it.

ACCEPTED AS FIXED — do not touch: the exact 31-row canonical roster;
owner-to-bead-evidence binding; readiness query ID uniqueness within a row;
replacement of synthetic sentinels with real record/source/page anchors.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/bootstrap-capability-ledger.json
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/bootstrap-capability-ledger.md
  packages/core/src/rules/bootstrapCapabilityLedger.ts
  packages/core/test/bootstrapCapabilityLedger.test.ts

=== SUPERVISOR DECISION ON P1-A — SEPARATE THE TWO NAMESPACES ===
The identity incompatibility with PR #475 is a CATEGORY ERROR, not a validation
gap, and widening #475's facet vocabulary would be the wrong fix.

'obl:::<sourceRef>:::<locator>:::<facet>' denotes a SOURCE OBLIGATION. #477
currently mints that shape for things that are not source obligations at all —
facets 'readiness-hook', 'code-symbol', 'ownership' and 'primitive-relevance'
describe EVIDENCE ITEMS. Only 'projection-absence' is arguably a real source
obligation, and only when tied to a genuine source clause.

FIX:
 * Use 'obl:::' ONLY for genuine source obligations, and only with a CANONICAL
   SemanticFacet drawn from the same vocabulary PR #475 validates. Import
   nothing across branches; duplicate the vocabulary locally and add a parity
   test asserting the two lists match, so drift is caught.
 * Mint evidence-item identities in a DISTINCT namespace — e.g.
   'ev:::<kind>:::<row>:::<discriminator>' — which #475 will never be asked to
   join against.
 * Bind each obligation identity's sourceRef and locator to that obligation's
   own authoritative evidence, as #475 does.
 * Reject duplicate identities REGISTRY-WIDE, not per row.
Concrete divergences to fix: the first row's audit identity names indep:001
while its evidence cites sol:CAP-002; shared owners reuse identical bead
obligation IDs across rows; two different primitives reuse the Aboleth
projection-absence identity.

=== P1-B: AUDIT RELEVANCE IS PROSE-SHAPED, NOT EVIDENCE-BACKED ===
The validator proves a sentence quotes the selected subject and has enough
unique wording. It does not prove the finding actually DISCOVERED the primitive.
The reviewer confirmed five unsupported mappings:
  wizard spellbook copying        -> '221 magic items blocked by engine'
  short-rest Hit Dice             -> Natural Recovery
  derived attack/AC/proficiency   -> inconsistent damage field names
  canonical currency mutation     -> Tack/Harness/Drawn Vehicles taxonomy
  downtime procedures             -> '221 magic items blocked by engine'
FIX: a citation is valid only when the finding's own recorded scope covers the
primitive. Where it does not, DROP the citation — a row may stand on
readiness/code/bead evidence alone. Do not rewrite the sentence to sound better;
that is the same prose-shaped failure. Fix all five, then re-audit every
remaining audit-finding citation against the finding's scope in
/mnt/d/eshyra-2026-07-24-audit-repair-bead-plan.md.

=== P1-C: KNOWN-MISSING ROWS STILL DO NOT PROVE SEMANTIC ABSENCE ===
The resolver checks a generated pack record exists with some nonempty data, then
searches readiness clauses for one exact proposed hook name. That proves neither
that the source clause exists at the anchor NOR that an equivalent or partial
representation is absent elsewhere. Multi-save incompleteness is anchored to the
generic Saving Throws rule rather than to the entries whose later saves were
dropped. The test only proves an injected hook label is detectable.
FIX, for each of the 12 rows:
 (a) anchor to the SPECIFIC source material whose projection is missing — for
     multi-save, the entries that dropped later saves, not the generic rule;
 (b) prove the source material is present at that anchor;
 (c) prove no equivalent or PARTIAL representation exists elsewhere in the pack,
     searching by semantic shape rather than by one proposed hook name.
If (c) cannot be established for a row, mark it evidence-underived so it FAILS
the closure predicate. An unprovable row must block, never pass.

=== P2-D: PROJECTION QUERY IDS CAN DUPLICATE WITHIN A ROW ===
Same-row uniqueness covers only readiness queries. A repeated
known-missing-source-clause with the same projectionQueryId and a different
obligation ID is still accepted, and the regression test covers only readiness
duplication. FIX: enforce uniqueness across ALL query-bearing evidence kinds
within a row, and extend the test.

=== ENVIRONMENT / CONSTRAINTS ===
npm ci first; npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing. Edit only the four
files above. Do not touch package.json, internal.ts, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md,
.github/, or any script/CI file. Do not regenerate the pack or run the importer.
Do not modify any bead but your own; no bd dolt push; no push, PR comment, or
merge. Never delete a test to make a finding disappear. The PR body is the
supervisor's to fix.
acceptance_criteria:
• obl::: is used only for genuine source obligations with canonical SemanticFacets; a parity test guards the vocabulary against PR #475 drift.
• Evidence-item identities use a distinct namespace and are never presented as source obligations.
• Obligation identity sourceRef and locator are bound to that obligation own evidence; duplicates are rejected registry-wide; the indep:001/sol:CAP-002, shared-bead and Aboleth divergences are fixed.
• The five unsupported audit citations are dropped or re-cited, and every remaining citation is re-audited against the finding recorded scope.
• Each known-missing row anchors to the specific unprojected source material, proves source presence, and proves absence of equivalent or partial representation; rows that cannot are evidence-underived and block closure.
• Query ID uniqueness within a row covers all query-bearing evidence kinds, with the test extended.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
